verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say the dot keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations [dots-docs-23]. They also say its memory persists across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls [dots-docs-5], and give an example of applying earlier context, such as flagging a conflict with a draft shared last week [dots-docs-24]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that memory recall works in practice, and documentation of how a power-user can view, edit, or scope what the dot remembers.
